title: Acervator - The Accumulation Trading Platform
author: Ekthelius
selftext:
Hello All,

My new custom Governance Execution Platform is now available for public testing and feedback:

[https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR](https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR)

It is a unique and powerful platform but is still in active development with plenty of polish still being needed but the core trading engine works and I have been actively testing it four months.

There is plenty information on the GitHub and under 'docs'.  Look forward to any input or testing results. 

  
Thanks,  
Ekthelius / Tony

comments.author: Ekthelius
comments.body:
If it helps, here is a direct link to the releases:

[https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR/releases](https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR/releases)

It is a stand alone application that does not require external server access or license keys.  

You launch it.  You add exchanges via API.  After connections are verified, you create bots and let it run.  

Additionally, you can find the Product Manual here:

[https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR/blob/current/docs/Acervator-Product-Manual.pdf](https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR/blob/current/docs/Acervator-Product-Manual.pdf)

And this has my testing / trading data going back to 4/12 that I am regularly updating while development proceeds.  So, unlike most auto-traders that will not show you real numbers AND require payment, I am providing proof that it can help and giving it to people to hopefully help mitigating poorly considered trades.

I has been downloaded a few times but am not receiving any useful feedback from anyone so am continuing on it solo until then.

Lastly, I have also created a rough draft for a New User Procedure.  This will be getting refined later as I get closer to a feature-complete and fully tested release.

[https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR/blob/current/docs/new-user-procedure/New-User-Procedure.pptx](https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR/blob/current/docs/new-user-procedure/New-User-Procedure.pptx)
